native_fa3_gate.note: constant-value kernel canary, not model quality certification

native_fa3.kv_scales: fixed per-sequence/KV-head from FP16 prefix only
native_fa3.arithmetic: external FA3 FP8 path; PyTorch matmul flags do not control its internal arithmetic
native_fa3.output: FA3 BF16 output cast to FP16
native_fa3.workspace: FP16 producer pool retained for new KV writes; no full-pool dequantization

sweep.note: decode context is cached prefix + 1; independent histories, not autoregressive rollouts

scope: fixed-history full forwards; synthetic tokens; warm forward latency, not serving throughput

timing.order: control first, seeded shuffled candidates, control again

kv_storage.scale: FP32 per token per KV head
kv_storage.attention: FP16 FA3 with full-pool dequantization staging
kv_storage.limitation: extra FP16 workspace retained; timings include staging and do not establish native FP8 cache bandwidth gains

accumulation_note: FP32 accumulators and accuracy-oriented FP8 promotion requested; hardware instructions not profiled
